summary: Polkadot's launch page for Unbounded, a free, on-chain-funded wide geometric display family: a Lottie hero, then tilted marquee bands, a black tester card, greeting marquees, a pink glyph inspector, a purple figure-style switcher, variable-font recipes with 'Copy CSS code', a magnifier-lens anatomy section and a wall of the name scrolling behind Download/GitHub buttons. Built in Svelte on Locomotive Scroll, whose sections sit at opacity 0 outside the viewport, so every desktop crop after the hero is black; the reading below relies on the mobile capture and the HTML.

instances.look: Fixed corners only: pink dotted Polkadot ring logo top-left and a small white 'MENU' toggle top-right (menu contents are rendered on open, not in the DOM)

Black screen; a white disc rises from the bottom-left corner and 'THIS IS / UNBOUNDED' appears centred, the first line Light and the second Black; the name then breaks apart letter by letter as you scroll and the disc grows until the page turns white
instances.ux: Lottie animation on a full-viewport canvas, scrubbed by scroll (data-scroll-call='updateBackground' flips the page background); a cursor-follow element trails the pointer
instances.learn: Use one geometric shape (a circle growing from a corner) as the transition from a black hero to the white page, so the hero literally opens into the site

reconstruction.layout: Pinned section ~2 viewports (1800px); canvas 1440×900 fills the viewport; title centred at ~38% height, ~560px wide; the disc starts as a quarter circle ~420px radius at bottom-left and scales up
reconstruction.typography: 'THIS IS' ~64px Unbounded Light uppercase; 'UNBOUNDED' ~64px Unbounded Black uppercase, both centred, tight leading; rendered inside the Lottie canvas
reconstruction.behaviour: Lottie (canvas renderer) played or scrubbed on scroll; letters scatter vertically at t≈3s in the video; Locomotive Scroll smooth scrolling with data-scroll-speed parallax; background colour switched by the 'updateBackground' scroll call

instances.look: Three short centred paragraphs in Unbounded: 'Unbounded is possibly the first open source, freely available and on-chain funded font in the world.' then the six weights + variable font, Latin and Cyrillic with 1300 glyphs, and attention to African languages
instances.ux: Paragraphs drift at half scroll speed (parallax) as the disc expands behind them
instances.learn: Set the about text in the wide display face at a modest size and centre it: the width of the letters carries the identity even in body copy

reconstruction.layout: Centred column ~460px wide in the second viewport of the hero section, 3 paragraphs with one blank line between
reconstruction.typography: ~20px Unbounded Regular, centred, leading ~1.4, black on white (white on black while the disc is small)
reconstruction.content: Real positioning: free, on-chain funded, six weights + variable, 1300 glyphs, hundreds of languages incl. African ones

instances.look: Six slightly tilted bands stacked down the page, one per weight (ExtraLight, Light, Regular, Medium, Bold, Black), each a ruled strip with the weight name and a marquee of a crypto slogan in that weight ('Explore the blockchain multiverse.', 'Seamless on-chain upgrades.', 'Scalab…'), heavier bands overlapping lighter ones
instances.ux: Bands scroll sideways continuously; on mobile only the weight names show, rotated a few degrees
instances.learn: Give each weight its own tilted marquee band and stack them by z-index (heavier on top) so the weight range reads as a pile of moving tapes

reconstruction.layout: ~1240px tall; 6 full-width bands ~170px tall, each rotated ~-3° to +3°, 1px black rules top and bottom, overlapping slightly (z-index 1–5)
reconstruction.typography: Band text ~128px Unbounded at wght 200/300/400/500/700/900, sentence case; weight label in the same style
reconstruction.behaviour: CSS marquee per band (content + cloned content, translateX loop), started when intersecting (.intersect/.visible)
reconstruction.html: .weights > .title + .marquee-wrapper > .marquee.visible > .content + .content.cloned; inline style z-index + font-weight per band

instances.look: A big black rounded card: a row of white pill weight buttons (ExtraLight … Black; a select on mobile), three round alignment buttons, Size and Leading sliders, a 'TYPEWRITER' label and the editable sample 'Many chains, one network.' in white Bold at ~128px; two tilted ruled marquee strips follow ('ANY TYPE OF DATA ACROSS ANY TYPE OF BLOCKCHAIN.', '⭘ THE FUTURE IS MULTICHAIN. AND IT'S TAKING SHAPE NOW ON POLKADOT.')
instances.ux: Weight radios (200, 300, 400, 500, 700, 900), align radios left/centre/right, Size 1–18rem (step 0.1), Leading 0.9–2.5; type into the textarea
instances.learn: Put the tester on a dark card inside a light page and label it like a tool ('Typewriter'), with pill radios for named weights instead of a slider

reconstruction.layout: Card ~1360px wide, ~800px tall, ~40px radius, black; controls row at top (pills ~40px tall), sliders in a second row ~300px wide each; textarea fills the rest; marquee strips below, full-bleed, rotated ~2°
reconstruction.typography: Sample 12.8rem (≈128px with a 10px root) Unbounded Bold, leading 1, left-aligned, white; pill labels ~14px uppercase Unbounded; strips ~34px uppercase Regular
reconstruction.behaviour: Controls write inline font-weight, text-align, font-size (rem) and line-height on the textarea; strips are CSS marquees

instances.look: Four huge marquee lines of greetings in Unbounded Light joined by long arrows (Привіт ⟶ Habari ⟶ Pele o ⟶ / ⟵ Ndew ⟵ Hej ⟵ Hei ⟵ Olá / Bonjour ⟶ Hallo ⟶ Ciao ⟶ / ⟵ Labas ⟵ Witam ⟵ Hola!), with a magenta disc 'Over 400 supported languages · VIEW ALL' floating over them
instances.ux: Each line scrolls in the direction its arrows point (alternating); the disc moves at its own scroll speed (data-scroll-speed=1) and its button opens the full language list
instances.learn: Let the arrows inside the copy announce each marquee's direction, and use greetings, the first word anyone looks for in their language

reconstruction.layout: ~680px tall; 4 full-bleed lines ~150px pitch; disc ~400px diameter centred, overlapping lines 2–3
reconstruction.typography: Greetings ~128px Unbounded Light, arrows ⟶ ⟵ in the font; disc text ~22px Medium centred, 'VIEW ALL' 12px underlined
reconstruction.behaviour: Alternating-direction CSS marquees; parallax disc; button reveals the language list (overlay)
reconstruction.content: Greetings in Ukrainian, Swahili, Yoruba, Wolof, Swedish, Finnish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Lithuanian, Polish, Spanish

instances.look: A magenta rounded panel with a huge black 'A' preview and a category menu (VIEW ALL, BASIC UPPERCASE, BASIC LOWERCASE, LATIN EXTENDED ACCENTS, FIGURES, CIRCLES FIGURES, LIGATURES, ORDINALS, SUP/INF, CURRENCY, PUNCTUATION, SIGN & SYMBOLS, ARROWS & SHAPES, CYRILLIC, GREEK LETTERS), next to a white rounded grid of glyphs with the selected one in a black circle

reconstruction.layout: ~630px tall; desktop two panels side by side (preview ~700px square-ish magenta card, grid card with ~10 columns of ~50px cells, scrollable); mobile stacks them

reconstruction.content: 1082 glyphs by category, Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, circled figures, arrows
reconstruction.html: select.nav.btn.mobile-only (options View all … Greek letters) + desktop pill list; grid of glyph cells

instances.look: A purple rounded card with a pill select 'PILLED FIGURES ▾' and five centred lines 'Block number 42 / 856 / 677 / 365 / 26' in white, the numbers enclosed in pill outlines, weights stepping up line by line

reconstruction.layout: Card ~1360×780, ~40px radius; select pill centred near the top; 5 centred lines ~75px apart

reconstruction.html: select.nav.btn (Pilled figures / Plain figures / Circled figures)

instances.ux: Drag the slider (100–900) to change the weight of the phrase
instances.learn: A one-line joke headline plus one slider is enough to explain a weight axis

reconstruction.layout: ~790px; text column ~520px centred; headline centred below on 2–3 lines; slider ~330px wide, 20px tall dark track with white knob
reconstruction.typography: Paragraphs ~20px Unbounded Regular centred; headline ~110px Unbounded at the slider weight (default 400)
reconstruction.behaviour: input[type=range] sets font-weight on the headline

instances.variantDefinition: Cards that each play a variable-font animation on a UI-like sample (a button label, a headline) on hover or in a loop, each with a 'Copy CSS code' button that copies the keyframes so visitors can reuse the effect
instances.look: Two white outlined cards side by side: a purple pill button reading 'Truly decentralized' (letters as separate spans) and 'Future-proof' in big black type, each with a 'COPY CSS CODE' pill under it
instances.ux: Hovering a card plays its animation (per-letter weight wave on the button, wdth/wght keyframes on the headline, captured at wdth 85 wght 100); the button copies the CSS
instances.learn: Ship the animation, not just the demo: a copy button next to each variable-font effect turns the specimen into a snippet library

reconstruction.layout: ~620px; two equal cards ~660×520 with 1px black border and ~30px radius; sample centred, copy pill bottom-centre
reconstruction.typography: Button label ~28px Unbounded Light white on purple pill; 'Future-proof' ~80px Unbounded Bold; copy pills 12px uppercase
reconstruction.behaviour: Hover on .hover.wrapper triggers keyframes (svelte font-animation on 'wdth'/'wght'); per-letter <i> spans for staggered animation; copy to clipboard
reconstruction.html: div.hover.wrapper > div.col > span.btn-preview > span.center > i×n; button.btn.big 'Copy css code'

instances.look: 'Anatomy' heading and 'Distinctive forms and unconventional details, as disruptive as the movement that inspired them.', then 'ENDLESS' and 'possibilities' at display size with purple dots on the letters joined by thin leader lines to small purple captions (Extend width, 90 degree terminals, Chevron stems, Large x-height with short extenders, Chevron detailing, Side-eye counters, Mix of humanist & grotesk forms, Narrow apertures)
